import pandas as pd, numpy as np, statsmodels.api as sm
df = pd.read_csv('data/explore.csv')
exposures = ['canopy_cover','soil_moisture','elevation_m','road_dist_km','leaf_litter','temperature_c','slope_deg','nitrate','grazing_index','rainfall_mm']
d = df.dropna(subset=['species_richness']).copy()
# region dummies
reg = pd.get_dummies(d['region'], prefix='reg', drop_first=True).astype(float)
for e in exposures:
    dd = d.dropna(subset=[e])
    X = pd.concat([dd[[e]], reg.loc[dd.index]], axis=1)
    X = sm.add_constant(X)
    m = sm.OLS(dd['species_richness'], X).fit()
    print(f"{e:15s} coef={m.params[e]: .4f} se={m.bse[e]:.4f} p={m.pvalues[e]:.4f}")
